checkbox.name: Disable Phantom Notes
checkbox.desc: When Checked removes phantom notes from You Can't Run and Triple Trouble

checkbox.name: Mod Shaders
checkbox.desc: When Checked, the game will use the mod's custom shaders. If Checked, this may cause performance issues on some devices.

checkbox.name: Camera Flashing
checkbox.desc: When Checked, the camera will flash stuff on screen during certain events. This may cause discomfort for some players.
